name: Love Nocturna
source:
You stumble into a town, enshrouded and plagued, and straight into a beast's clutches. Can you earn your escape?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你误打误撞闯入了一座被迷雾与瘟疫笼罩的小镇，更一头栽进了野兽的魔爪之中。你能否靠自己挣得一线生机？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
